turns.customer: I've used the Glowworm headlamp from order #1050 on a few night hikes, and now it won't turn on, even with new batteries. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Since the headlamp stopped working after use rather than arriving damaged, it cannot be returned under our standard return policy. However, it may be covered under our one-year warranty if it is a manufacturing defect and not normal wear or accidental damage. I have escalated this to our team (ticket #ESC-35), and a human support agent will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
